source: Ed4 C.6.5 and C.6.6, pp.C-71 to C-73; C.7.6.3, pp.C-120 to C-122; corpus-format.md 6.2 step 6
description: With probe_run set, MAX-SPEED moves up one rung after that many clean bursts on its rung even when the estimate does not call for it; LOW-SPEED does not.
note: Table (corpus-format.md 6.1) as drc-rx-trial-after-clean-run with probe_run 3. Flow as drc-rx-trial-after-clean-run, whose table this is with probe_run 3 added: conn 1 binds SAP 5; at 1000 to 3000 a burst holding a PADDING from 0.0.1.3 to us with CAPABILITY (Ed4 1), EOT 10, records 0.0.1.3 Ed4 (C-1261); the request at 1500 queues "hello" for 0.0.1.3; at 52000 one transmission (WN 2 Long) holds the type 7 and 20 PADDING D_PDUs, all to 0.0.1.3, whose 21 EOWs are the top priority of Table C-25 (MAX-SPEED, LOW-SPEED), then SENDER-APPROACH 0xB04, then the rotation MAX-SPEED, LOW-SPEED, MAX-SEGMENT 0xAFF from its start (interp C-1260, C-1286). Earlier bursts (burst_started, bytes_received 30 ms later, burst_ended 60 ms later) hold a PADDING with EOT 0 (C-0105), or a type 7 to us whose data CRC fails (a D_PDU error, C-0836). Codes: MAX-SPEED 0x8A0 + WN and LOW-SPEED 0x9A0 + WN at Long (C-0462, C-0469). Table positions: WN 2, 4, 6, 7 Long are 0 to 3; bulk thresholds on WN 4 Long -100, 0, 100, 150, on WN 6 Long -100, 0, 300, 500, on WN 7 Long -100, -50, 100, 400; latency on WN 4 Long -100, 100, 300, 400, on WN 6 Long -100, 200, 400, 600, on WN 7 Long -100, 0, 300, 600; smoothing weight 8, clean run 2, error limit 500 ppt, caps 2 doubling to 8. The probe (corpus-format.md 6.2 step 6, interp C-1291) is for MAX-SPEED only. At 100 a clean burst on WN 4 Long, estimate 50: S = 50; bulk target 1 (0; 100 is above), latency target 0 (100 is above); the first recommendation is the target, not above WN 4 Long's own position 1: MAX-SPEED WN 4 Long, LOW-SPEED WN 2 Long. WN 4 Long's clean run is 1. At 200 the same: S stays 50, the targets are unchanged and equal to the recommendations, so no trial; the clean run is 2, which is clean_run but short of probe_run 3, so MAX-SPEED holds. The CAPABILITY burst, clean, on WN 4 Long, estimate 50: the clean run of the MAX-SPEED rung is 3, the target (1) is not above MAX-SPEED (1) and position 1 is not the top, so MAX-SPEED moves up one rung, to WN 6 Long (interp C-1291); LOW-SPEED stays WN 2 Long, since the probe is for MAX-SPEED only. EOWs: 0x8A6, 0x9A2, 0xB04, then 0x8A6, 0x9A2, 0xAFF repeated, 21 in all. Without probe_run (drc-rx-trial-after-clean-run's table) MAX-SPEED would have stayed WN 4 Long.
